events.title: Ada 83 standard approved (ANSI/MIL-STD-1815A)
events.summary: ANSI approved the Ada 83 reference manual on February 17, 1983 — the DoD-mandated language for safety-critical systems.
events.about: Ada was designed for avionics, defense, and embedded systems — strong typing, tasks (concurrency), exceptions, and packages for large-team engineering. Boeing, Airbus, and military contractors still maintain millions of lines of Ada. Spark Ada adds formal verification for code that must not fail.

narrative.whyChosen: Ada 83 was the first language standardized under a rigorous DoD procurement mandate.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved a language could be engineered for reliability and maintainability at government scale.
narrative.problemSolved: DoD projects used hundreds of incompatible languages; the Steelman requirements demanded one portable, verifiable standard.
